story_title: A Visit to the City Art Gallery
task_instruction: Rewrite each direct wh-question as a reported question.
paragraphs: Mia visits the City Art Gallery with her class. At the entrance, their guide, Alex, welcomes them. Alex asked Mia, {{red:Where do you usually see art?}} {{mask_1}} Mia said she sometimes saw art at school. Alex asked, {{red:What kind of paintings do you like?}} {{mask_2}} Mia said she liked paintings of places. Alex asked, {{red:Who is your favorite artist?}} {{mask_3}} Mia named an artist she had studied in class. Alex asked, {{red:When did you last visit an art gallery?}} {{mask_4}} Mia said she had visited one with her family the year before.

The class enters the first room, which has landscape paintings. Alex asked Mia, {{red:Which painting do you like best?}} {{mask_5}} Mia pointed to a picture of the sea. Alex asked, {{red:Why do you like that painting?}} {{mask_6}} Mia said the bright colors made her feel happy. Alex asked, {{red:How does the painting make you feel?}} {{mask_7}} Mia answered that it made her feel calm. Alex asked, {{red:What can you see in the background?}} {{mask_8}} Mia noticed a small boat near the shore.

In the next room, the students look at portraits. Alex asked Mia, {{red:Who is the person in this portrait?}} {{mask_9}} Mia read the name on the wall label. Alex asked, {{red:What is the artist showing in this picture?}} {{mask_10}} Mia thought the artist was showing a family at home. Alex asked, {{red:How many people are in the portrait?}} {{mask_11}} Mia counted four people. Alex asked, {{red:Which people are smiling?}} {{mask_12}} Mia looked closely and said that two of them were smiling.

The guide takes the class to a room with sculptures. Alex asked Mia, {{red:What is this sculpture made of?}} {{mask_13}} Mia read that it was made of wood. Alex asked, {{red:How tall is the sculpture?}} {{mask_14}} Mia checked the information card. Alex asked, {{red:Where was it made?}} {{mask_15}} Mia saw that it had been made in a nearby town. Alex asked, {{red:Why did the artist choose this material?}} {{mask_16}} Mia guessed that the artist liked its natural color.

Before the visit ends, the class goes to a small activity room. Alex asked Mia, {{red:What are you drawing?}} {{mask_17}} Mia said she was drawing the sea painting. Alex asked, {{red:Who is helping you with the drawing?}} {{mask_18}} Mia said her classmate Ben was helping her. Alex asked, {{red:When will you finish your picture?}} {{mask_19}} Mia said she would finish it after lunch. At the exit, Alex asked, {{red:What did you learn today?}} {{mask_20}} Mia said she had learned to look carefully at colors, shapes, and details.
